advisor.name: Anthony Smith
advisor.title: Financial Advisor
advisor.bio: Anthony Smith is an Investment Adviser Representative with MRB Capital Group, a family office serving clients nationwide. Having spent his career in financial services, he's focused on helping individuals and families work toward financial freedom through comprehensive financial planning. He works with pre-retirees, retirees, small business owners, and high-net-worth individuals, and holds a B.S. in Finance from Metropolitan State University along with the FINRA Series 7 and 66 registrations and a Minnesota life, accident, and health insurance license. He lives in the St. Paul area with his wife and their daughter, Lana, and is currently accepting new clients.
